title: Ravens WR Rashod Bateman not participating in OTAs because of a personal matter

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Ravens WR Rashod Bateman not participating in OTAs because of a personal matter
sources.description: Ravens wide receiver Rashod Bateman is absent from organized team activities, and offensive coordinator Declan Doyle said some "personal things" have kept Bateman away.
